description: This file defines an adapter class for displaying calendar days in a RecyclerView grid within an Android application, managing how individual days are styled and handled, including today highlighting and event indicators.

classes.name: CalendarDayAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for rendering calendar day items in a RecyclerView, handling styling based on whether the day is today, belongs to the current month, or has associated events.

classes.name: CalendarDayAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class managing the views for individual calendar days, including UI updates for styling and event indicators.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the list of CalendarDay objects to display and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a calendar day item and creates a DayViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a CalendarDay object to the ViewHolder for display.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of calendar days being displayed.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a CalendarDay data to the ViewHolder's views, applying styling rules for today and event indicators.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if a given date matches the current day.
